requirements.explanation: The tender closing date and time is Friday, 4 June 2021 at 3:00 p.m. Submissions after this time will not be considered.

requirements.original_text: Sample packaging method for (i) and (ii) above to be submitted together with tender documents
requirements.explanation: Tenderers must submit physical samples of the packaging methods for both individual starter packs and larger department boxes.
requirements.source_excerpt: Sample packaging method for (i) and (ii) above to be submitted together with tender documents

requirements.explanation: The company must be registered in Malaysia to be eligible for this tender.

requirements.original_text: Company with at least 3 years’ experience in supply and delivery of OSS related items
requirements.explanation: The company must demonstrate at least 3 years of experience specifically in supplying office supplies and stationery.
requirements.source_excerpt: b) Company with at least 3 years’ experience in supply and delivery of OSS related items;

requirements.original_text: Company with positive net worth in the last four financial years or the last four years bank statement, if sole proprietor (2017 to 2020)
requirements.explanation: The company must have a positive net worth for the years 2017-2020. Sole proprietors must provide bank statements for the same period.
requirements.source_excerpt: c) Company with positive net worth in the last four financial years or the last four years bank statement, if sole proprietor (2017 to 2020);

requirements.original_text: Declaration of no litigation or dispute has been instituted against the company and/ or its directors
requirements.explanation: A formal declaration must be provided stating that there is no ongoing litigation against the company or its directors.
requirements.source_excerpt: d) Declaration of no litigation or dispute has been instituted against the company and/ or its directors;

requirements.original_text: Tenderers to supply ALL required items based on scope of works mentioned in Section 1.1
requirements.explanation: Tenderers must be able to provide every item listed in the scope of work; partial bids are not allowed.
requirements.source_excerpt: e) Tenderers to supply ALL required items based on scope of works mentioned in Section 1.1 in RFP Document.

requirements.original_text: Each part (Part 1, Part 2 and Part 3) of the tender proposal is to be submitted together in three (3) separate envelopes.
requirements.explanation: The proposal must be split into three separate sealed envelopes: Envelope A (Mandatory), Envelope B (Technical), and Envelope C (Commercial).
requirements.source_excerpt: Each part (Part 1, Part 2 and Part 3) of the tender proposal is to be submitted together in three (3) separate envelopes.

requirements.original_text: to be deposited into Tender Box 7 or Tender Box 8
requirements.explanation: Tenders must be physically deposited into the specified tender boxes at Sasana Kijang, BNM.
requirements.source_excerpt: and to be deposited into Tender Box 7 or Tender Box 8 at address below

requirements.original_text: Tender proposals submitted by facsimile, e-mail, telex, telegram or any other means will NOT be considered or accepted.
requirements.explanation: Electronic submissions (email, fax, etc.) are strictly prohibited and will lead to disqualification.
requirements.source_excerpt: Tender proposals submitted by facsimile, e-mail, telex, telegram or any other means will NOT be considered or accepted.

requirements.original_text: successful tenderer is required to declare its current bank account particulars in the submission of the tender proposal.
requirements.explanation: Tenderers must include their bank account details in the proposal for e-payment setup purposes.
requirements.source_excerpt: the successful tenderer is required to declare its current bank account particulars in the submission of the tender proposal.

requirements.original_text: The contract tenure is for a duration of four (4) years (est. contract tenure effective from October 2021 to September 2025).
requirements.explanation: The contract duration is specified as four years, estimated from October 2021 to September 2025.
requirements.source_excerpt: The contract tenure is for a duration of four (4) years

requirements.original_text: A declaration of Withdrawal from Tender Participation (Form X, Attachment 4) shall be submitted if tenderer(s) decide not to participate in this tender exercise after the collection of tender document.
requirements.explanation: If a company collects the tender document but decides not to bid, they must submit a formal withdrawal declaration (Form X).
requirements.source_excerpt: A declaration of Withdrawal from Tender Participation (Form X, Attachment 4) shall be submitted

requirements.original_text: Successful Tenderer must submit its current bank account’s statement for purposes of creating the e-payment account with BNM.
requirements.explanation: The winning bidder must provide a current bank account statement to facilitate electronic payments from the Bank.
requirements.source_excerpt: Successful Tenderer must submit its current bank account’s statement

requirements.original_text: The successful tenderer shall enter into a service agreement with the Bank. The provisions relating to the limit of liability and delay and liquidated damages are non-negotiable by the successful tenderer.
requirements.explanation: The successful bidder must sign a service agreement where clauses regarding liability limits and liquidated damages for delays cannot be negotiated.
requirements.source_excerpt: provisions relating to the limit of liability and delay and liquidated damages are non-negotiable
